title: Hope
introduction: Hope is a sustaining force in the Christian life—a firm anchor for the soul. Christian hope is not uncertain wishful thinking, but a confident expectation based on God's promises and Christ's resurrection. Even in dark times, we can hold fast to hope.

sections.title: A Living Hope
sections.description: Through Christ's resurrection, we have received a living and unshakable hope.

sections.title: The Source of Hope
sections.description: God himself is the source of hope and gives us joy and peace.

sections.title: Hope in Suffering
sections.description: Even in difficult times, we can have hope because God is with us.

sections.title: The Anchor of Hope
sections.description: Hope is like a secure anchor for the soul, fixed in the holy place.

sections.title: Eternal Hope
sections.description: Our ultimate hope is the coming glory and the resurrection.
